caption: The drawing consists of several stylized flowers and leaves arranged against a rectangle filled with a dark green background, bordered by an off-white or light beige outer area. Within the green rectangular area, there are multiple flowers with thin, radiating petals: most of these flowers have petals in shades of light brown and pink, with lines of white accentuating the edges of the petals. The centers of these flowers are yellowish. There are also two flowers on the right side depicted in shades of blue and white with yellow centers, standing out from the predominantly brown-pink flowers. The leaves, emanating from a central stem, are elongated and pointed, rendered in a lighter green with fine parallel lines indicating leaf veins. All plant forms are shown in a flat, graphic style without shading, distributed evenly across the green rectangle. The drawing is centered on the page, and the background outside the green rectangle is plain and unadorned except for a few faint brownish spots.
title: Embroidered Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
